post.caption: My AI rockets crashed every time for 13 generations. Gen 14: one landed. Gen 15: zero again. Gen 20: 20. Gen 32: 37. Gen 53: 45. Each rocket is a small neural network that fires its thrusters; the best landers get copied with mutations.
post.pinned: Each rocket is a small neural network that controls its thrusters. No one tells it how to land. The best ones get copied with random mutations into the next generation.
